lines.text: Endmin, here to check on the progress of Yinglung Pass outpost development? Here's the latest data.

options: Thanks. I'll take a look on my own.
Not really. I'll check with you later.

scenes.summary: Wei Xidong introduces the structure of the Xiranflow Cloudseeder and his future plans. His words are filled with hope and positive expectations.

lines.text: The current Xiranflow Cloudseeder can only seed basic clouds for rain. We'll conduct additional surveys to know how to upgrade the cloudseeding engine to its final build.
The Xiranflow Cloudseeder will be origin from which we expand outwards. We'll grow more plants to solve soil erosion and sedimentation...
I'm so looking forward to the pretty version of Yinglung Pass!
The Xiranflow Cloudseeder won't be our only focus... We'll also remediate the natural environment of Yinglung Pass and take care of the bodies of water, the vegetation, and fowlbeasts.

scenes.summary: Tianshi Wei Xidong is in charge of expanding Yinglung Pass and constructing a Xiranflow Cloudseeder. However, shortage of Separator Cores is imposing a serious delay on the work. You decide to deploy a Sub-PAC according to plan to support Xiranflow Cloudseeder construction.

lines.text: No, there's still a hiccup somewhere... I gotta wait a bit more.
Erm ... Tianshi Wei, can we start working already? Hello?
Ah, Endministrator. I'm Overflow of the YSTF.
Task Leader Arcane told us to meet you. Thanks for making this trip.
Greetings! Is that guy the one leading Team Tianshi?
Ahem. Tianshi Wei is knowledgeable but he ran into a problem. He's been studying it, but he's also delaying the work as we speak.
We have other duties at Yinglung Pass and can't wait around forever. If we don't start now...
If you're willing to take over this job, I'll be overjoyed. Yinglung Pass means a lot to us. Feel free to call me if you need any help.
Endministrator! Am I glad to see you here! Tianshi Zhuang told you about the project, right?
Constructing the ⟦key|Xiranflow Cloudseeder⟧ is central to this expansion. This facility will seed the skies with Xiranite vapors to induce rain that mitigates the residual Blight.
But ... completing the Xiranflow Cloudseeder within schedule has proved ... quite a difficult task...
The supply of Separator Cores needed by the Xiranflow Cloudseeder is unstable. I'm also concerned with the comments provided within the plan...
"Let heavens and waters blend into each other"... "Raise the trees and let them blossom forth"... "Emulate the fowls that wait for seasonal winds"... Waters, trees, and fowls. What do they refer to?
The one who left these comments is ... Well, she was my mentor and ... she's no longer around...
Waters, trees, and fowls... Perhaps the place needs more than just a Xiranflow Cloudseeder. Every plant and critter of Yinglung Pass is part of something greater.
Oh, that must be it! We must go beyond the Xiranflow Cloudseeder... I got an idea! Still, we're going to tackle the problems one at a time, Endmin. The Separator Cores...
Don't worry. We've verified the Sub-PAC deployment site, right? We can get the ball rolling straight away.
Sounds great to me!

options: Go ahead and do your thing. We got this.
Tell me more about the difficulties.

scenes.summary: The deployment has left Wei Xidong impressed with the beauty of the AIC Factory. He then informs you of the number of Separator Cores needed in the early phase.

lines.text: Is this the Endfield Automated Industry Complex...? Witnessing it with my own eyes truly feels different...
Every module of the Xiranflow Cloudseeder needs a large number of ⟦key|Separator Cores⟧. For the early phase, we might need ... fifteen of them. Endmin, how long would this take you...?
Once the production line is in place, we'll meet the quota soon enough.
Thank you so much! I'll also use this opportunity to study my mentor's comments. She definitely has a few words of wisdom for us...
Endmin, these ⟦key|Separator Cores⟧ are crucial for constructing the Xiranflow Cloudseeder.
Your AIC Factory ... is amazing. It produced Separator Cores of this caliber within short notice...
Our AIC Factory has all sorts of artsy features, you know!
We can finally get started! Your Xiranflow Cloudseeder, my mentor... Our friends of Endfield will help me achieve our goal...
I've actually read the production reports. But seeing it myself is ... very awe-inspiring...
